event.description: Factor learned positional embeddings through a learned rank-8 code and projection while retaining d=14, two heads, two blocks, and ff=20.
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3528 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted result; attempt-0001 replaced learned positions with fixed sinusoids and was an optimization failure (0% validation throughout 30000 steps); 1 prior attempt. Hypothesis: learned low-rank positional codes retain adaptable position-specific alignment while constraining the position matrix, unlike the failed all-fixed encoding. This is a representational factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. The rank-8 code/projection reduces positional degrees of freedom while preserving a learned mapping to the d=14 residual stream. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative rank 4 because rank 8 first tests a modest rank constraint that can distinguish redundant positional directions from the need for fully independent position vectors.
